info.title: AgentDrive REST API
info.description: The HTTP surface that the AgentDrive MCP server, CLI and SDKs wrap: versioned workspace files, cross-agent session resume, semantic search, run provenance, sharing and org management. Errors are `{ "success": false, "error": "..." }`, sometimes with a machine-readable `code`. Paginated lists return `data` with a sibling `cursor`; pass it back as `?cursor=` until it is null.

get.description: Reports whether KV and R2 answer reads, with the deployed version. Needs no authentication. Answers 503 with the same body when either store is unavailable.

post.summary: Register an agent and create its org
post.description: Creates a new org on the trial plan and its first agent, and returns that agent's API key. The key is shown only in this response. Needs no authentication; rate-limited per IP. On a self-hosted instance it needs X-Bootstrap-Token.

parameters.name: X-Bootstrap-Token
parameters.description: Self-hosted instances only: the operator's bootstrap token, without which registration is closed.

get.description: Says which human sign-in methods this instance has configured. Needs no authentication.

post.description: Emails a 6-digit sign-in code. While a code is live, a resend repeats it. At most 5 codes an hour per address (429 rate_limited); after 5 wrong codes the address is locked for 15 minutes (429 too_many_attempts). Both 429s carry Retry-After. Needs no authentication; rate-limited per IP. Disabled (501) on a self-hosted instance.

post.summary: Exchange a sign-in code for a session
post.description: Checks the emailed code and returns a session. Send the session_id as X-Session-Token on later requests. Creates an org for the email if it has none. 5 wrong codes lock the address for 15 minutes (429 too_many_attempts with Retry-After). Needs no authentication; rate-limited per IP. Disabled (501) on a self-hosted instance.

get.description: Returns who the credentials on this request belong to: a session (with its org), an agent API key, or a share link.

post.description: Deletes the session sent in X-Session-Token. Answers 400 for any other kind of credential.

Starts a device-style sign-in. Show user_code in the terminal, open auth_url in a browser, then poll /v1/auth/cli/poll with id and device_code. A body without shows_user_code: true answers 400 cli_outdated. Needs no authentication; rate-limited per IP. Not available (501) on a self-hosted instance.

Reports the state of a CLI sign-in. When status is complete the response carries the new API key once. refused carries the plan-limit error and upgrade link; denied means too many wrong user codes. Needs no authentication.

Called by the signed-in browser with the user code shown in the terminal. Mints an API key for the CLI. Wrong codes answer 400 wrong_code; too many end the sign-in (403 denied). Session only; rate-limited per IP.

get.description: Returns what a share link opens and whether it is email-gated, without using it. Needs no authentication.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The share token from a share link.

get.description: Lists the workspaces in the caller's org, 50 a page. Not available to share links.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page.

post.description: Creates a workspace in the caller's org. Answers 402 when the plan's workspace limit is reached.

get.description: Reads a workspace. A share link must be for this workspace and not scoped to one file.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

put.summary: Assign a bucket to a workspace
put.description: Sends the workspace's new writes to a bring-your-own bucket (or back to the AgentDrive bucket with 'default'). Existing files keep reading from where they were written. Org owner or admin only; a bucket other than AgentDrive R2 needs the Team plan (403 plan_required).

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

delete.description: Sends the workspace's new writes back to the AgentDrive bucket. Org owner or admin only.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

get.description: Lists file metadata in a workspace, 50 a page, optionally under a path prefix. A file-scoped share link sees only its file.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Only paths starting with this.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page.

post.description: Creates a file at path, or adds a new version when the path exists (200 instead of 201). Needs edit permission. An API key may name a workspace that does not exist yet in place of {wid}; the write creates it, which can answer 402 at the workspace limit.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

get.description: Reads a file's metadata, and its content with content=true. Reading a session transcript (sessions/<project>/<harness>/<id>.md) from a different harness counts as a cross-agent resume, which can answer 402 when the monthly resume limit is enforced. A content read through a share link counts toward its max_uses.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: fid
parameters.description: File id.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Include the file content.

200.description: The file; with content when content=true.

put.description: Writes a new version of an existing file by id. Needs edit permission.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: fid
parameters.description: File id.

delete.description: Deletes a file and its versions. API keys only.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: fid
parameters.description: File id.

get.description: Lists a file's version history, 50 a page.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: fid
parameters.description: File id.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page.

get.summary: List runs that touched a file
get.description: Lists the agent runs that referenced or produced this file. Not available to share links.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: fid
parameters.description: File id.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page.

post.description: Re-embeds the current version for semantic search, after checking the stored bytes match the content hash. Changes no versions, activity or usage. The vector index applies the change asynchronously, so poll search for availability. Org owner or admin only; shares the search rate limit.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: fid
parameters.description: File id.

get.description: Lists a file's comments, 50 a page.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: fid
parameters.description: File id.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page.

post.description: Adds a comment, optionally anchored to a line range. Needs comment permission. Agent feedback is stored as comments.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: fid
parameters.description: File id.

get.description: Lists the workspace's activity events (writes, comments, shares, roles), 50 a page.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page.

get.description: Lists the workspace's share links with their use counts. Only principals in the workspace's own org; anyone else gets 404.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page.

post.description: Mints a signed share link for the workspace or one file. An email-gated workspace link also grants that email a role in the workspace. Only principals in the workspace's own org; anyone else gets 404.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

delete.description: Revokes a share link, and the role an email-gated link granted. Only principals in the workspace's own org.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: tid
parameters.description: Share link id (token_id).

get.description: Lists the email role grants on a workspace. API keys only.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page.

post.summary: Grant an email a workspace role
post.description: Gives an email view, comment or edit permission on the workspace; that person then reaches it signed in. Replaces any role the email had. API keys only.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

delete.description: Removes an email's role grant. API keys only.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address, URL-encoded.

post.summary: Clone a repo into the sandbox
post.description: Experimental. Clones a git repository into the workspace's Linux sandbox. Needs edit permission in the workspace's own org. Answers 503 when the instance has no sandbox.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

post.summary: Run a command in the sandbox
post.description: Experimental. Runs a shell command in the workspace's sandbox; output is truncated past a size cap. Needs edit permission in the workspace's own org. Answers 503 when the instance has no sandbox.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

get.summary: Read a file from the sandbox
get.description: Experimental. Reads a file from the workspace's sandbox filesystem; {path} is the rest of the URL and may contain slashes. Principals in the workspace's own org only. Answers 503 when the instance has no sandbox.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Sandbox file path; may contain slashes.

post.description: Experimental. Commits all changes in the sandbox repository and records the commit as a workspace artifact. Needs edit permission in the workspace's own org. Answers 503 when the instance has no sandbox.

parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Workspace id (ws_...). An API key or session may also pass a workspace name from its own org.

post.description: Semantic search across the org's files, falling back to keyword search when nothing matches semantically. Optionally limited to one workspace and filtered by agent platform, agent or path prefix. Not available to share links; has its own rate limit.

post.summary: Get relevant context for a task
post.description: Returns the artifacts most relevant to a task description, ranked by semantic match and recency with agent-platform diversity, each with why it was surfaced and the last run that referenced it. Not available to share links; shares the search rate limit.

Records what an agent did: the task, the artifacts it read and produced, its status and tool calls. Sending an existing run_id updates that run (200 instead of 201). The run takes its platform and role from X-Agent-Platform and X-Agent-Role. API keys only.

get.description: With project, lists that project's runs (optionally one platform). Otherwise lists one agent's runs: agent_id, or the calling key's own. A session with neither gets the newest 50 runs across the org's agents, with no further pages.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project slug the runs were logged under (metadata.project).

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: With project: only runs from this platform.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: With project: page size, default 50; values above 100 are treated as 100.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Without project: list this agent's runs.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page.

get.description: Reads one run in the caller's org.

parameters.name: rid
parameters.description: Run id.

get.description: Activity across every workspace in the org, newest first: which agent did what, on which artifact. Page back with since= set to the oldest event's created_at; cursor is always null. Not available to share links.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only events after this ISO 8601 time.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Events to return, default 200, at most 1000.

get.description: Reads the caller's org with its agents, members, pending invites (each paged separately), usage and plan quota. On a self-hosted instance every quota is null (unlimited).

parameters.name: agents_cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for the next page of agents.

parameters.name: members_cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for the next page of members.

parameters.name: invites_cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for the next page of invites.

patch.description: Changes the caller's org name. Only org owners and admins, the keys they mint, and a self-registered org's founding agent may rename it; anyone else gets 403.

post.summary: Invite a person to the org
post.description: Invites an email to the org and emails them a sign-in code. The invite grants nothing until they accept it signed in. Only an owner can invite an owner, and only an owner or admin (or a key one of them made) an admin. Answers 402 at the seat limit. Disabled (501) on a self-hosted instance.

get.description: Lists the invites addressed to the signed-in email. Session only.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page.

post.description: Joins the inviting org and makes it the session's org. Session only, as the invited email. Answers 402 at the seat limit.

parameters.name: org_id
parameters.description: Id of the org that sent the invite.

post.description: Deletes an invite addressed to the signed-in email. Session only.

parameters.name: org_id
parameters.description: Id of the org that sent the invite.

delete.summary: Remove a member or revoke an invite
delete.description: Removes the member, revokes a pending invite to that email, or both; removal also ends the keys, links and grants they issued. Owners remove anyone; admins and a registered org's founding agent remove non-owners; a member may remove themselves. The last owner cannot be removed (409).

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address, URL-encoded.

get.description: Lists the org's managed API keys, never the secrets.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page.

post.description: Mints a new API key; each key is its own agent principal. The secret is returned only in this response. Answers 402 at the plan's agent limit.

delete.description: Revokes a key, ending the share links and role grants it issued. A key can revoke itself and keys it created; a session can revoke keys it created, and an owner any key.

parameters.name: key_id
parameters.description: API key id.

post.description: Stores credentials for a Cloudflare R2 (cross-account) or S3-compatible bucket; those providers need endpoint, region, bucket, access_key_id and secret_access_key. Run verify before use. Org owner or admin only; a provider other than agentdrive-r2 needs the Team plan (403 plan_required).

get.description: Lists the org's bucket configs, without secrets.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page.

get.description: Reads one bucket config, without its secret.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Bucket config id.

delete.description: Deletes a bucket config. Answers 409 while any workspace still uses it. Org owner or admin only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Bucket config id.

post.description: Writes, reads back and deletes a probe object in the bucket. Success marks it healthy; failure marks it degraded and answers 502 with the error. Org owner or admin only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Bucket config id.

get.description: Reads the org's plan, usage against quota (including this month's cross-agent resumes) and the usage status every surface shows. Disabled (501) on a self-hosted instance.

post.description: Opens a Stripe Checkout session for Pro or Team (Team takes seats, default 3). Org owner or admin only. Disabled (501) on a self-hosted instance.
Returns a Stripe Customer Portal link for changing or cancelling the subscription. Answers 409 before the org has subscribed. Org owner or admin only. Disabled (501) on a self-hosted instance.

parameters.name: cli
parameters.description: Return to the CLI billing page afterwards.

get.description: Lists the org's 12 most recent Stripe invoices; empty before the org has subscribed. Org owner or admin only. Disabled (501) on a self-hosted instance.

apiKey.description: An agent API key from /v1/register or /v1/keys. One key is one principal; X-Agent-Platform and X-Agent-Role tell its sessions apart in provenance.

session.name: X-Session-Token
session.description: A human session id from /v1/auth/verify-code or OAuth sign-in. An email-gated share link needs it too, signed in as that email.

shareToken.name: X-Share-Token
shareToken.description: A share token from a share link; it carries its own permission and scope. Not accepted as a bearer token.

shareTokenQuery.name: token
shareTokenQuery.description: The share token as a query parameter, as share URLs carry it.

AgentPlatform.name: X-Agent-Platform
AgentPlatform.description: The harness making the call, recorded in provenance. Read only with an API key; case-insensitive, and any other value is recorded as unknown.

AgentRole.name: X-Agent-Role
AgentRole.description: Free-form role of the agent (e.g. planner, coder, reviewer), recorded on runs. Read only with an API key; truncated to 64 characters.

code.description: Machine-readable code, when the route sets one (e.g. rate_limited, plan_limit).

UsageWarning.description: Present when the org is at 80% or more of a plan limit.

content.description: null when the stored bytes cannot be read.

granted_via.description: Share link id when an email-gated link created the role.

prefix.description: First and last characters of the key, for recognising it.

last_run.description: The most recent run that referenced the artifact.

BucketConfig.description: A bring-your-own bucket. The secret access key is never returned.

artifact_path.description: Workspace path of the commit record written for other agents.

path.description: Workspace-relative path, e.g. notes/plan.md. Writing to an existing path adds a version.

message.description: Version message recorded in the history.
Version message recorded in the history.

bucket_config_id.description: A bucket config id from /v1/bucket-config, or 'default' for the AgentDrive bucket.

file_id.description: Scope the link to this one file; omit for the whole workspace.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the link expires; omit for no expiry.

max_uses.description: Content reads and writes the link allows; omit for unlimited.

email.description: Gate the link to this email: it then also needs a session signed in as that email.

cursor.description: Pass as ?cursor= for the next page; null when there are no more.

context.description: The workspace_id and token_id sent with send-code, if any.

user_code.description: Show to the user; they type it in the browser.

device_code.description: Secret the CLI keeps and polls with.

email_hint.description: Masked email of an email-gated link.

BadRequest.description: The request body or query failed validation.

Unauthorized.description: Credentials are missing, invalid, expired or revoked.

PlanLimit.description: The org is at a plan limit; the body says which and links the upgrade.

Forbidden.description: This principal may not do this.

NotFound.description: Not found, or not visible to this principal.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current state.

RateLimited.description: Rate limited; retry after Retry-After seconds.

InternalError.description: The operation failed on the server.

BadGateway.description: An upstream service (Stripe, email, a storage bucket or the vector index) failed.

Unavailable.description: A required service is not configured on this instance.
